# Space and Tech Engineering LLP

> Made in India drone components. Space and Tech Engineering LLP is an Indian drone electronics company with offices in Mumbai and Nashik. It designs and sells the Aazmuth and Exelr8 flight controllers, Skydrive AM32 ESCs and NAVSATE GPS modules for UAV and FPV builders.

Key facts:
- Products: Aazmuth and Exelr8 flight controllers, Skydrive AM32 ESCs (40A, 60A, 55A 4-in-1), NAVSATE GPS modules.
- Offices: Mumbai (registered office) and Nashik (product development centre), Maharashtra, India.
- Use cases: agriculture, survey and mapping, defence and industrial, FPV racing, education, startups.
- OEM and bulk orders: arup@spaceandtech-engineerings.com, +91 96657 17903.

## Products
- [Aazmuth flight controller](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/aazmuth-flight-controller.html): Modular, triple-redundant flight controller with isolated sensors.
- [Exelr8 FPV flight controller F7](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/exelr8-fpv-flight-controller-f7.html): F7 flight controller for FPV builds.
- [Skydrive AM32 60A 3-6S](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/skydrive-am32-60a.html): 60A AM32 speed controller for 3-6S batteries.
- [Skydrive AM32 40A 3-6S](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/skydrive-am32-40a.html): 40A AM32 speed controller for 3-6S batteries.
- [Skydrive 55A AM32 4-in-1](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/skydrive-55a-am32-4-in-1.html): 4-in-1 AM32 ESC for FPV drones.
- [NAVSATE GPS for UAVs](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/navsate-gps-for-uavs.html): GPS module tuned for UAVs.
- [NAVSATE mini for FPV drones](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/navsate-mini-gps.html): Compact GPS for FPV drones.
